test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 10th December 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the combination of letters that when sequentially placed in the blanks of the given series will complete the series.

L P_ S T _ _ Q _T L _ _ S T
solution:
Given :- L P_ S T _ _ Q _T L _ _ S T

By checking options and substituting accordingly.

1) QLPSPQ → L P **Q** S T - **L P** Q **S** T - L** P Q** S T

 
• Here **"LPQST"** is repeated.

2) PQSLSP → L P **P** S T - **Q S** Q **L** T - L **S P** S T

3) PQLQLP → L P **P** S T - **Q L** Q **Q** T - L **L P** S T

4) LQPQSP → L P **L** S T - **Q P** Q **Q** T - L **S P** S T

 
• Option (3) gives the pattern of :- L P Q S T - L P Q S T - L P Q S T

Hence, the correct answer is **"QLPSPQ".**
